source.directorySummary: Implements the file `diff` command for previewing workspace-relative git diffs, handling single-file and timeline/commit variants with repository resolution, truncation limits, and CLI/web rendering.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Implements adaptDiffCommand that validates path/repository/timeline/commit options, resolves the file repository root, delegates to handleDiff/handleTimeline/handleCommit handlers, and renders web or CLI output.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines diffDefinition factory for the `diff` subcommand with required path argument and optional previousDir, timeline, commit, and repository options.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Implements handleDiffCommand, handleTimelineDiffCommand, and handleCommitTimelineDiffCommand that resolve workspace paths, run git diff/status via spawnSync, handle untracked/binary/truncation (256KB limit), and parse patches into structured results.

summary.value: plugins/file/commands/diff implements the `file diff` command for previewing workspace-relative git diffs, supporting single-file and timeline/commit variants with repository resolution, truncation limits, and CLI/web rendering. Web UI is delegated to renderers, which builds styled diff cards/timeline output with breadcrumb, line-numbered patches, and git-state notices.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Read-only inspection leaf within the git-operations family of the plugins/file/commands aggregation. Positioned beneath the centralized file dispatcher (plugins/file/adapter.ts/handleFile) and registration (init.ts) seam alongside commit/history/restore/init, it provides non-mutating preview complementary to those mutating peers. Follows the shared validate-containment/repository-resolution → execute → adapt pattern via shared/ helpers, fans out internally across single-file/timeline/commit variants, and delegates all web presentation to renderers/ while keeping CLI output in the adapter layer.

files.adapter.ts: Orchestration/selection layer for the diff subcommand — validates mutually exclusive path/repository/timeline/commit options, resolves the file's repository root via shared workspace utilities, fans out to the three handle* handlers, and adapts structured results to CLI text or web UI via renderers/. Depends on definition.ts contract upstream and isolates rendering from git execution in handler.ts.
files.definition.ts: Declarative CLI contract that registers the diff subcommand within the 20-command file plugin registry. Defines the required path argument and optional previousDir/timeline/commit/repository surface consumed by the central dispatcher for parsing, help generation, and pre-validation before adapter.ts is invoked; contains no runtime git or rendering logic.
files.handler.ts: Stateless git execution core called by adapter.ts — resolves workspace-relative paths, invokes git diff/status via spawnSync, handles untracked/binary/truncation (256KB) edge cases, and parses patches into structured results for timeline, commit-timeline, and single-file variants. Supplies renderer-agnostic data consumed by adapter/renderers without owning CLI/web formatting.
